enabled_sessions.name: Enabled Sessions

max_messages_per_minute.name: Max Messages Per Minute
max_messages_per_minute.hint: Trigger rate limiting when this count is exceeded

max_wakeups_per_minute.name: Max Wakeups Per Minute
max_wakeups_per_minute.hint: Trigger rate limiting when LLM wakeup count is exceeded

cooldown_seconds.hint: Messages are discarded during the cooldown period after rate limiting

cooldown_reply.hint: Send a reply when the bot is mentioned during cooldown

zh.name: 冷却期回复
zh.hint: 冷却期间被提及时发送回复告知对方

cooldown_reply_enabled.hint: Whether to send a reply during cooldown when mentioned

cooldown_reply_text.name: Reply Text
cooldown_reply_text.default: 我现在比较忙，请稍后再找我~
cooldown_reply_text.hint: The reply text sent during cooldown when mentioned

zh.name: 回复内容
zh.hint: 冷却期间被提时时发送的回复文字

queue_mentions.name: Queue Mentioned Messages
queue_mentions.hint: Whether to queue messages that mention or reply to the AI during cooldown

zh.hint: 冷却期内是否保留提及或引用 AI 的消息等待合并处理

owner_ids.hint: One ID per line, messages from these users bypass rate limiting
